decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - 4. The development hereby permitted shall be used for only activities ancillary to the authorised office use of the site

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The storage area hereby permitted shall be used only for storage ancillary to the estate agency use of the premises and for no other purpose (including any purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any order revoking or re-enacting that order).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to offices
